mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.user_id, b.month, b.category_id, b.limit_amt, b.warn_threshold, b.update_time, CASE WHEN b.category_id = 0 THEN '月度总预算' ELSE c.name END AS category_name FROM budget b LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = b.category_id AND c.user_id = b.user_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.month = #{month} ORDER BY b.category_id ASC

SELECT b.id, b.user_id, b.month, b.category_id, b.limit_amt, b.warn_threshold, b.update_time, CASE WHEN b.category_id = 0 THEN '月度总预算' ELSE c.name END AS category_name FROM budget b LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = b.category_id AND c.user_id = b.user_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY b.month DESC, b.category_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO budget (user_id, month, category_id, limit_amt, warn_threshold) VALUES (#{userId}, #{month}, #{categoryId}, #{limitAmt}, #{warnThreshold}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE limit_amt = VALUES(limit_amt), warn_threshold = VALUES(warn_threshold)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM budget WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
